title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Incentive Statement — Amount of the Enrollment Bonus
content:
**Statement.** The flown spend since approval of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is the total of every spend entry posted to the agreement. When that flown spend has reached the tier's enrollment-bonus spend, the enrollment bonus credited is the tier's enrollment-bonus points, credited as they stand. When the flown spend has not reached the tier's enrollment-bonus spend, or when the tier carries no enrollment-bonus points, the enrollment bonus credited is nothing.

### Outcomes

| Flown spend since approval | Tier's enrollment-bonus points | Enrollment bonus credited |
|---|---|---|
| has reached the tier's enrollment-bonus spend | more than zero | the tier's enrollment-bonus points |
| has reached the tier's enrollment-bonus spend | zero | nothing |
| has not reached it | any | nothing |

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

- On a tier whose enrollment-bonus spend is USD 2500 and whose enrollment-bonus points are 2500, spend entries totalling USD 2500.00 reach the spend exactly, and 2500 points are credited.
- On the same tier, spend entries totalling USD 2499.99 have not reached it, and nothing is credited.
- On a tier whose enrollment-bonus points are zero, nothing is credited whatever the spend.
